changelog: Open/Save/Share buttons now center icon+text together as one group with reference-sized icons; completed check circle shrunk to reference size and all row/tab/tile icons re-proportioned; film tile redrawn as the reference clapperboard-on-screen with lime play triangle; Home background is now your own image (dark navy + glowing teal film strips + wave); app renamed to MollywoodSearchApp (heading + launcher name; greeting is now just Hey, user!); full-width Resume Download button removed from Downloads rows (right-side pause/play circle is the only control); new Go to downloads button appears below Home results while a download is active; Downloads 3-dot menu now holds only Check for updates; update check fixed to read the installed version at runtime so it correctly says You are on the latest version instead of re-downloading; update download popup widened to near full-width with standard file-card colors.
